name: group row order comes from the adoption sequence, not the declared order
why: 🎹 is adopted on the initial render and would head the View group; nothing errors.
grep: each group adopts the real buttons

name: a group's adopt() does not stamp the owner, so _toolbarInvoke() cannot find the host
why: Ctrl+D then clicks a row in a closed panel: a zero rect, and the density pull-down lands in the top-left corner.
grep: Ctrl\+D opens the menu

name: _toolbarInvoke() does not open the host menu first
why: The same zero-rect corner placement, by the other half of the pair.
grep: Ctrl\+D opens the menu

name: activating a row no longer closes the menu
why: The menu would stay over the dialog or panel the row opened.
grep: the menu opens on click and closes on Escape

name: a choice in a submenu closes only the submenu
why: After exporting, the SAED menu would stay open over the page.
grep: choosing a format closes the submenu AND the menu

name: opening a menu does not close the others
why: An indicator's list and the SAED menu would stack over each other.
grep: opening an indicator's list closes the SAED menu

name: a group's shortcut hint is appended as text instead of an attribute
why: A read of the row would then be label plus hint.
grep: a row carries its shortcut hint as an attribute

name: the capture-phase mousedown dismiss is dropped
why: A link click whose leave-page confirm is cancelled never reaches a bubbling click listener.
grep: leave-page confirm is cancelled

name: the menu always opens below its segment, uncapped
why: Near the window's bottom its rows are off-screen and unreachable.

edits.find: const up = height > below && above > below;
edits.replace: const up = false; const room0 = below; void room0;

grep: fits in the window

name: Keyboard Shortcuts never moves to Help
why: It would stay alone in View before loading, which the approved View rule forbids. (A first version of this mutation forced the row into View on the line before; the next line moved it back, so it changed nothing.)
grep: before anything is loaded, View is not shown

name: no area is marked first
why: The button would start with a heavy rule on its left edge.
grep: one segmented button

name: the Tampermonkey ChangeLog entry shows every group
why: "📜 ChangeLog" would open the whole menu instead of the changelog choices.

edits.find: const shown = hasRow && (k !== 'load' || narrow) && (!only || k === only);

grep: Tampermonkey .📜 ChangeLog. entry opens the menu

name: the narrow rule never applies
why: On a phone the actions crowd the bar and wrap it onto several lines.
grep: on a narrow screen

name: a submenu opens over its parent instead of beside it
why: The formats would cover the menu rows the pointer is on.
grep: hovering Export opens the formats beside the menu

name: the parent keeps the keyboard while its submenu is open
why: Arrow keys would move focus in both menus at once.
grep: → opens the submenu on its first format

name: the card shows over the open menu
why: The SAED card would cover the menu it describes.
grep: the ☰ SAED card names the script

name: a blank menu name stays blank
why: The segment would read "☰" with nothing after it.
grep: a blank menu name falls back to SAED

name: What's new opens the development log
why: Users asking what changed would land on 1,600 technical entries.
grep: Help, What's new and the full log each open

name: the library's remote changelog is configured again
why: The 1.75 MB fetch, GM cache and parse on every page would be back, with a second 📜 entry.
grep: the library does not fetch, store or parse the changelog

name: the Tampermonkey ChangeLog entry is not registered
why: The menu entry users know would silently disappear.
grep: Tampermonkey .📜 ChangeLog. entry opens the menu

name: the Shift-click branch comes back as a dead route
why: Shift-clicking Help would open nothing at all now that the dialog is gone.
grep: Shift-clicked

name: prefix-mode H opens something else
why: The keyboard route to help would be lost.

edits.find: 'h': { fn: openAppHelp, description: 'Open App Help on GitHub' },
edits.replace: 'h': { fn: () => {}, description: 'Open App Help on GitHub' },

grep: prefix-mode H opens the GitHub help page

name: an empty indicator stays in the bar
why: The emptiness reconcile is a second line behind lazy creation; no fixture empties a created indicator, so this is recorded rather than unmentioned.
grep: one segmented button
